record_audits.database_subject: CATH-2-derived antimicrobial peptide inhibits multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli infection in chickens.
record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (93.33%) to CATH-2(1-15) R: 33%, F: 20%, I=K: 13%.
